customManagers.description: Devcontainer Dockerfile ARG pins — suffix-matched so the template's Dockerfile.jinja (inside a jinja-named directory) is managed too
Workflow tool pins (both root and template workflows), `version:` style

GitHub Action SHA pins (`uses: owner/repo@sha # vX.Y.Z`) in the template's .jinja workflows — the native github-actions manager can't parse the .jinja extension, so these pins rotted silently until the omator retro caught them
Taskfile tool pins (root Taskfile + included taskfiles/, both layers), `FOO_VERSION: x.y.z` var style — used by foreman:lint's uvx-pinned ruff/black

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before proposing any update
Batch all GitHub Actions updates into one PR
Batch regex-managed workflow updates into one PR
Batch all Docker image updates into one PR
Batch all devcontainer updates (base image + annotated tools) into one PR — must come after the Docker images rule so the base image lands here instead
Template workflow action pins belong with the GitHub Actions batch, not the Devcontainer batch — must come after the Devcontainer rule so this override wins
Batch the web-astro test-fixture dependency bumps into one PR (the fixture validates the shipped ESLint config; its deps move together)
Batch the web-app test-fixture dependency bumps into one PR

Eject anthropics/claude-code-action from the batched GitHub Actions group and skip the 3-day release-age wait. It ships near-daily first-party releases, so grouping + minimumReleaseAge kept the whole Actions batch perpetually pending on the renovate/stability-days gate — each rebase pulled in a fresh release and reset the 3-day clock. It's a trusted first-party action and all updates are reviewed manually (automerge is off globally). Must come LAST so this override wins over every grouping rule (GitHub Actions, Devcontainer, template workflow pins).
